latest_decision: Atom.Header.Container is an ordinary single Property holding a full Scope Unit path or a base Atom ID selecting Current by default; Header.Relations is optional and contains no duplicate Container entry. IS_CONTAINED_BY/CONTAINS and +>/<+ remain MODEL/Formal Claim relations, not Property aliases. Scope Unit root formal containment and the Declaration Atom Header are distinct.
limits: Preserve P2694 Summary and original Header in preview; root assigns successor and canonical metadata when preparing an actual Draft.
No actual Epic, matrix, source, data, code, tests, Workflow, Workbench or Git mutation.
Detailed Header value encoding and schema support must follow reviewed source authority; no runtime behavior is asserted.
